UI_Holdoor_welcome_intro1: Game of Thrones style wave defense.
UI_Holdoor_welcome_intro2: Mark your base and the Iron Throne appears:
UI_Holdoor_welcome_intro3: defend it from the hordes. If it falls, you lose.
UI_Holdoor_welcome_tip1: F10 opens the waves panel (in multiplayer, host only).
UI_Holdoor_welcome_tip2: On the right is the HUD: waves, items and the shop.
UI_Holdoor_welcome_tip3: Between waves, spend your coins in the Shop.
UI_Holdoor_welcome_dontshow: Do not show this message again
UI_Holdoor_welcome_chatcopied: Guide copied to clipboard. Paste it (Ctrl+V) in your browser:
UI_Holdoor_panel_defensa: Defense Mode: defend the Iron Throne
UI_Holdoor_panel_defensadesc: If enabled, the Throne falls when zombies break it. You lose the game.
UI_Holdoor_modo_facil_desc: The dead are still learning to walk.
UI_Holdoor_modo_facil_lore: A trial for those just taking up arms. The night is long, but not endless.
UI_Holdoor_modo_normal_desc: The horde grows. The pressure doubles.
UI_Holdoor_modo_normal_lore: Here the real challenge begins. Those who survive the first night find the second is worse.
UI_Holdoor_modo_dificil_desc: The Night King advances. No mercy.
UI_Holdoor_modo_dificil_lore: Only the best reach the fifth wave. Here there is no room for doubt.
UI_Holdoor_modo_pesadilla_desc: There is no mercy beyond the Wall.
UI_Holdoor_modo_pesadilla_lore: A constant cascade of the dead. Completing this is a title few hold.
UI_Holdoor_modo_test_lore: Wave 1: slow. Wave 2: crawlers. Wave 3: fast.
UI_Holdoor_modo_test_detalle: 10 fixed x3 | no scaling | no SR | 10s prep
UI_Holdoor_modal_quitarbase:
You are about to remove the base and DESTROY the current Throne.

You will lose the base's visual progress (the Throne's HP is lost too).

This CANNOT be done during an active wave.

Confirm?
UI_Holdoor_chat_seguroon: [HOLDOOR] Coin insurance enabled. If you die during the wave, your balance is kept.
UI_Holdoor_chat_quitaroleadaactiva: [HOLDOOR] You can't remove the base during an active wave. Stop the waves first.
